en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a hilly rural village with scattered houses, fields, and dense trees. A church or chapel with a clock tower and dome stands prominently in the lower right area. The village stretches across the slopes with farm buildings and winding paths visible. At the upper left, the printed caption reads "Oberkipsdorf", and across the top center there is a large handwritten red number.
